name: ibis Styles Bogor Pajajaran
short_description: A 171-room design-economy hotel on Jalan Raya Pajajaran, directly opposite the Bogor Botanical Gardens.
ai_summary: ibis Styles Bogor Pajajaran sits on Jalan Raya Pajajaran in central Bogor, directly opposite the Bogor Botanical Gardens and within walking distance of the Bogor Presidential Palace and the Lawang Suryakencana food street. Built around the brand's colorful 'Dancing in the Rain' design concept, the 171-room hotel has an all-day dining sTREATs Restaurant, a lounge bar, fitness center, 10 meeting rooms, a kids' corner, and free bicycles for guests. It's about 2.2 km from the Jagorawi toll gate and 2.7 km from Bogor Station. Guests consistently praise the clean, comfortable rooms, friendly and responsive staff, and the unbeatable walk-to-everything location in central Bogor.

faqs.question: Is ibis Styles Bogor Pajajaran close to the Botanical Gardens?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it sits directly opposite the Bogor Botanical Gardens on Jalan Raya Pajajaran, with the pedestrian entrance reachable on foot from the hotel lobby. The location also puts the Bogor Presidential Palace and the Lawang Suryakencana food street within an easy walk of the 171-room hotel.

faqs.question: Does ibis Styles Bogor Pajajaran have meeting facilities?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it has 10 meeting rooms, the largest at 152 sqm, accommodating up to 100 guests for meetings or 80 for banquets, plus wedding facilities for up to 200 people. The design-economy hotel also offers free bicycles and a kids' corner for guests attending events with family in tow.
